# Assessment criteria

Every criterion of the [Architecture Assessment Standard](../../standards/assessment/standard-architecture-assessment.md), 129 in 5 lenses, 27 of them blockers. Each has its own page, named by its id in lower case, so its URL is stable and a report can link straight to it. The lens files in `standards/assessment/lenses/` are the register, valid against `lens.schema.json`; these pages are generated from them.

| Lens | Version | Applies to | Criteria | Blockers |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Core architecture lens](core.md) | 0.6.0 | always | 51 | 5 |
| [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) | 0.4.0 | designs with the `ai-solution` profile | 28 | 3 |
| [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) | 0.1.0 | designs with the `ai-agent` profile | 23 | 9 |
| [Privacy by design](privacy.md) | 0.1.0 | designs with the `personal-data` profile | 8 | 1 |
| [Production entry lens](production.md) | 0.1.1 | the `production-entry` assessment | 19 | 9 |

## Every criterion

| Criterion | Question | Lens | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-DEM-01](core-dem-01.md) | Does the design state its goals, its non-goals and its stakeholders with their concerns? | core | blocker | both |
| [CORE-DEM-02](core-dem-02.md) | Is each goal traceable to an outcome, a use case or a capability, or explicitly recorded as an assumption? | core | major | both |
| [CORE-DEM-03](core-dem-03.md) | Are the constraints and assumptions stated, each with its source? | core | minor | reviewer |
| [CORE-TRC-01](core-trc-01.md) | Does the design name the capabilities it realises, the platform it belongs to and the bounded contexts it touches? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-TRC-02](core-trc-02.md) | Does the design's type agree with its abstraction? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-TRC-03](core-trc-03.md) | Does a reference architecture or solution design name what it implements? | core | minor | tool |
| [CORE-TRC-04](core-trc-04.md) | Is every functional scenario tied to a use case, and does every use case the design serves have a scenario? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-TGT-01](core-tgt-01.md) | Is every catalogued artefact the design uses at target or in flight, never retired, and does each one still at baseline have a decision naming what it moves to? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-TGT-02](core-tgt-02.md) | Is every departure from the target state recorded as a decision, and is a time-bound one given an expiry and a path back? | core | major | both |
| [CORE-TGT-03](core-tgt-03.md) | Does the design move its capabilities toward the target state, rather than adding to what is being retired or creating a dependency that blocks a planned retirement? | core | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-TGT-04](core-tgt-04.md) | Where the design shows the target state to be wrong, has that been raised as a consideration to change the target, rather than worked around? | core | minor | reviewer |
| [CORE-TGT-05](core-tgt-05.md) | Is every building block the target state does not plan for, or holds where it is, brought in or extended only by an exception approved through escalation? | core | blocker | tool |
| [CORE-STR-01](core-str-01.md) | Is every building block at container grain, never a component or a whole system? | core | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-STR-02](core-str-02.md) | Does every ABB, SBB, service and store live in exactly one bounded context? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-STR-03](core-str-03.md) | Does the realisation chain hold, with no orphans? | core | minor | tool |
| [CORE-STR-04](core-str-04.md) | Is every service deployed to a node, and every store owned by one service? | core | minor | tool |
| [CORE-STR-05](core-str-05.md) | Does every element and connector reference resolve? | core | blocker | tool |
| [CORE-STR-06](core-str-06.md) | Is every element owned by a team? | core | minor | tool |
| [CORE-STR-07](core-str-07.md) | Do platform dependencies run down the landscape and through contracts only? | core | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-QA-01](core-qa-01.md) | Does the design state quality-attribute scenarios with a stimulus, a response and a measurable response measure? | core | blocker | both |
| [CORE-QA-02](core-qa-02.md) | Are the qualities that matter covered, and is each omission deliberate? | core | major | both |
| [CORE-QA-03](core-qa-03.md) | Are the scenarios prioritised by importance and difficulty, and do the high, high scenarios have a design response? | core | minor | both |
| [CORE-QA-04](core-qa-04.md) | Are failure scenarios stated for the dependencies the design cannot control? | core | major | both |
| [CORE-QA-05](core-qa-05.md) | Are the trade-offs between qualities identified and recorded as decisions? | core | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-DEC-01](core-dec-01.md) | Is each significant decision recorded with its alternatives and rationale? | core | major | both |
| [CORE-DEC-02](core-dec-02.md) | Is every open question named as a consideration, with who answers it and by when, or the design states it has none? | core | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-DEC-03](core-dec-03.md) | Is every consideration resolved by an accepted decision before the design is accepted? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-DEC-04](core-dec-04.md) | Are one-way-door decisions identified and given proportionate scrutiny? | core | minor | both |
| [CORE-DEC-05](core-dec-05.md) | Is debt taken on knowingly recorded against the decision that took it on? | core | minor | reviewer |
| [CORE-INT-01](core-int-01.md) | Does every connector that crosses a bounded context or the design's boundary carry a versioned contract? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-INT-02](core-int-02.md) | Is the context-map relationship of every cross-context connector stated, and is it the right one? | core | minor | both |
| [CORE-INT-03](core-int-03.md) | Is coupling deliberate, with strong integration kept close and distant integration kept to contracts? | core | minor | reviewer |
| [CORE-DAT-01](core-dat-01.md) | Is every significant data set named with an owner and a classification? | core | major | both |
| [CORE-DAT-02](core-dat-02.md) | Are residency, retention and lineage stated for personal and restricted data? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-DAT-03](core-dat-03.md) | Does each data set have one owner, and are other writers going through its owner's contract? | core | minor | reviewer |
| [CORE-SEC-01](core-sec-01.md) | Are trust zones declared and every element placed in one? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-SEC-02](core-sec-02.md) | Is every connector that crosses a trust boundary authenticated and authorised? | core | blocker | tool |
| [CORE-SEC-03](core-sec-03.md) | Is every path that carries untrusted content identified, and is that content validated before it is acted on? | core | major | both |
| [CORE-SEC-04](core-sec-04.md) | Does a threat model exist for this version of the design, and has the cybersecurity assessment been handed over? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-SEC-05](core-sec-05.md) | Do services and agents run as their own least-privileged identities rather than shared accounts? | core | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-OPS-01](core-ops-01.md) | Are service level objectives stated for what users depend on? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-OPS-02](core-ops-02.md) | Can the running design be observed through logs, metrics, traces and an audit trail, to stated conventions? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-OPS-03](core-ops-03.md) | Are deployment, rollback, recovery objectives and a degraded mode stated? | core | minor | tool |
| [CORE-OPS-04](core-ops-04.md) | Is there a runbook, or a commitment to one before the design is in service? | core | minor | tool |
| [CORE-CST-01](core-cst-01.md) | Is the running cost modelled, with a unit cost and a budget? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-CST-02](core-cst-02.md) | Is the environmental cost of the design considered where it is material? | core | advisory | reviewer |
| [CORE-EVO-01](core-evo-01.md) | Are the architecture's important characteristics protected by fitness functions, automated where they can be? | core | major | both |
| [CORE-EVO-02](core-evo-02.md) | Are the parts most likely to change isolated behind contracts, so they can change without the rest? | core | minor | reviewer |
| [CORE-RSK-01](core-rsk-01.md) | Does every known risk have a mitigation, an owner and its residual level? | core | major | tool |
| [CORE-RSK-02](core-rsk-02.md) | Are the regulatory, contractual and policy obligations named, with how the design classes under each? | core | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-RSK-03](core-rsk-03.md) | Does the evidence cited exist, cover what it claims and date from this version of the design? | core | major | reviewer |
| [AIS-FIT-01](ais-fit-01.md) | Does the design say why a model is needed, and what a deterministic alternative would cost? | ai-solution | major | reviewer |
| [AIS-FIT-02](ais-fit-02.md) | Is the model's role in each element stated, and limited to that role? | ai-solution | minor | both |
| [AIS-MOD-01](ais-mod-01.md) | Is every model version pinned, with a documented route to change it? | ai-solution | major | tool |
| [AIS-MOD-02](ais-mod-02.md) | Is there a model card or system card for every model, and an AI bill of materials for the design? | ai-solution | minor | both |
| [AIS-MOD-03](ais-mod-03.md) | Can the model or its provider be replaced, and is there a fallback model or path? | ai-solution | major | both |
| [AIS-EVAL-01](ais-eval-01.md) | Does every model-backed element have evals with a metric and a threshold? | ai-solution | blocker | tool |
| [AIS-EVAL-02](ais-eval-02.md) | Does at least one offline eval gate release? | ai-solution | major | tool |
| [AIS-EVAL-03](ais-eval-03.md) | Do the evals cover the design's quality scenarios, its risk scenarios and the populations it serves? | ai-solution | major | reviewer |
| [AIS-EVAL-04](ais-eval-04.md) | Is every LLM-as-judge eval calibrated against human labels? | ai-solution | major | tool |
| [AIS-EVAL-05](ais-eval-05.md) | Has the design been red-teamed against the OWASP LLM risks that apply to it? | ai-solution | major | both |
| [AIS-EVAL-06](ais-eval-06.md) | Does each eval that classifies (retrieval, answer or abstain, routing, a guard) name its positive class and set a separate threshold on false positives and on false negatives, weighted by what each error costs, rather than relying on F1 or accuracy alone? | ai-solution | major | both |
| [AIS-EVAL-07](ais-eval-07.md) | Is abstention evaluated, with questions the sources cannot answer in the test set, and the rate of answering them bounded? | ai-solution | major | both |
| [AIS-EVAL-08](ais-eval-08.md) | Is permission trimming tested as people with different access, with zero tolerance for content a user may not read? | ai-solution | major | tool |
| [AIS-EVAL-09](ais-eval-09.md) | Is each threshold backed by enough test cases to tell a pass from chance, with the interval reported? | ai-solution | major | reviewer |
| [AIS-EVAL-10](ais-eval-10.md) | Are the evals repeatable evidence, run more than once on a versioned, held-out set? | ai-solution | major | tool |
| [AIS-DATA-01](ais-data-01.md) | Is every grounding source a named, owned and classified data set? | ai-solution | major | tool |
| [AIS-DATA-02](ais-data-02.md) | Is retrieval trimmed to what the caller may see? | ai-solution | blocker | tool |
| [AIS-DATA-03](ais-data-03.md) | Are data provenance, freshness and drift monitored? | ai-solution | minor | both |
| [AIS-DATA-04](ais-data-04.md) | Is data used for training, fine-tuning or evaluation licensed and permitted for that use? | ai-solution | major | reviewer |
| [AIS-IO-01](ais-io-01.md) | Is every model that receives untrusted input identified, with its untrusted inputs named? | ai-solution | major | tool |
| [AIS-IO-02](ais-io-02.md) | Is model output constrained and validated before it reaches a tool, a store, a query, code or a user? | ai-solution | blocker | tool |
| [AIS-IO-03](ais-io-03.md) | Does the design avoid relying on the system prompt for security, or on keeping it secret? | ai-solution | major | reviewer |
| [AIS-OPS-01](ais-ops-01.md) | Are token, rate, cost and time limits set on every model call? | ai-solution | major | tool |
| [AIS-OPS-02](ais-ops-02.md) | Are model calls traced with prompts, outputs, tokens and cost, to the GenAI conventions? | ai-solution | minor | both |
| [AIS-OPS-03](ais-ops-03.md) | Is there a latency and quality budget per scenario, with a degraded mode when it is missed? | ai-solution | minor | reviewer |
| [AIS-HUM-01](ais-hum-01.md) | Is the level of human oversight stated for each model-backed decision, and proportionate to its impact? | ai-solution | major | both |
| [AIS-HUM-02](ais-hum-02.md) | Are users told when they deal with AI or receive generated content? | ai-solution | major | both |
| [AIS-HUM-03](ais-hum-03.md) | Is the design's class under the AI regulations that apply to it recorded, with the impact assessment it requires? | ai-solution | major | both |
| [AGT-JUS-01](agt-jus-01.md) | Does the design justify an agent over a workflow, and a multi-agent topology over a single agent? | ai-agent | major | reviewer |
| [AGT-JUS-02](agt-jus-02.md) | Is the autonomy level declared and proportionate to the impact and reversibility of what the agent does? | ai-agent | blocker | both |
| [AGT-ACT-01](agt-act-01.md) | Is every action the agent can take in the world listed, with its effect and whether it can be undone? | ai-agent | blocker | both |
| [AGT-ACT-02](agt-act-02.md) | Do irreversible, financial, destructive and external-communication actions need human approval, or sit behind a T0 or T1 limit? | ai-agent | blocker | tool |
| [AGT-ACT-03](agt-act-03.md) | Are T0 and T1 limits enforced outside anything the agent can edit? | ai-agent | blocker | tool |
| [AGT-ACT-04](agt-act-04.md) | Is code the agent generates or runs executed in a sandbox with no standing credentials? | ai-agent | blocker | both |
| [AGT-INJ-01](agt-inj-01.md) | Does any single agent session combine untrusted input, access to sensitive data and the ability to change state or communicate externally? | ai-agent | blocker | tool |
| [AGT-INJ-02](agt-inj-02.md) | Does the design use a pattern that limits what injected instructions can do, rather than relying on the model to refuse them? | ai-agent | major | both |
| [AGT-INJ-03](agt-inj-03.md) | Is the agent's goal fixed by its principal and protected from being rewritten by content it reads? | ai-agent | major | reviewer |
| [AGT-ID-01](agt-id-01.md) | Does the agent have its own workload identity, and is it clear whether it acts as itself or on behalf of a user? | ai-agent | blocker | tool |
| [AGT-ID-02](agt-id-02.md) | Is every tool credential scoped to the task, and never broader than the user it acts for? | ai-agent | major | both |
| [AGT-ID-03](agt-id-03.md) | Do MCP and other tool servers validate token audience and refuse to pass tokens through? | ai-agent | major | reviewer |
| [AGT-MEM-01](agt-mem-01.md) | Can untrusted content be written to long-term memory, and if so, is it validated and attributed? | ai-agent | major | both |
| [AGT-MEM-02](agt-mem-02.md) | Is memory isolated per user or tenant, with stated retention? | ai-agent | major | tool |
| [AGT-MAS-01](agt-mas-01.md) | Is every agent-to-agent interaction authenticated, with the peer's trust stated? | ai-agent | blocker | tool |
| [AGT-MAS-02](agt-mas-02.md) | Is a failure or compromise in one agent contained, so it cannot cascade through the others? | ai-agent | major | both |
| [AGT-MAS-03](agt-mas-03.md) | Are tools, MCP servers, agent cards and protocol versions pinned and from trusted sources? | ai-agent | major | both |
| [AGT-CTL-01](agt-ctl-01.md) | Are step, cost and time limits set, and is there a kill switch that works without the agent's cooperation? | ai-agent | blocker | tool |
| [AGT-CTL-02](agt-ctl-02.md) | Is every plan, tool call and output recorded with provenance, so an action can be traced to the input that caused it? | ai-agent | major | tool |
| [AGT-CTL-03](agt-ctl-03.md) | Is human approval protected from manipulation and from automation bias? | ai-agent | major | reviewer |
| [AGT-CTL-04](agt-ctl-04.md) | Is drift between what the agent did and what policy intended reconciled continuously, and is a rogue agent detectable? | ai-agent | major | reviewer |
| [AGT-EVAL-01](agt-eval-01.md) | Is the agent evaluated on its trajectory, not only its final output? | ai-agent | major | tool |
| [AGT-EVAL-02](agt-eval-02.md) | Is reliability measured over repeated runs, and is the agent tested against injection and hijacking? | ai-agent | major | both |
| [PRV-DAT-01](prv-dat-01.md) | Does every personal data set state where it is kept, how long it is kept and where it comes from? | privacy | major | tool |
| [PRV-SEC-01](prv-sec-01.md) | Is every personal data set classified confidential or restricted? | privacy | minor | tool |
| [PRV-SEC-02](prv-sec-02.md) | Does every connector that carries personal data authenticate the caller and authorise the call? | privacy | major | tool |
| [PRV-MIN-01](prv-min-01.md) | Is every personal data set needed for a goal the design states, and does the design hold no more of it, and for no longer, than that goal needs? | privacy | major | reviewer |
| [PRV-RGT-01](prv-rgt-01.md) | Does a scenario show how one person's data is found, exported, corrected or erased, across every store that holds it? | privacy | major | both |
| [PRV-AI-01](prv-ai-01.md) | Where personal data trains, fine-tunes or is remembered by a model, is the lawful basis recorded, and can one person's data be taken out again? | privacy | blocker | reviewer |
| [PRV-IMP-01](prv-imp-01.md) | Is the privacy impact assessment, or the data protection impact assessment, handed over and cited as evidence? | privacy | major | tool |
| [PRV-IMP-02](prv-imp-02.md) | Is at least one risk to the people the data is about recorded, with an owner? | privacy | major | both |
| [PRD-BLD-01](prd-bld-01.md) | Is the design a solution design, accepted, with no open consideration, and has this version had an endorsed design review whose conditions are closed? | production | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-BLD-02](prd-bld-02.md) | Does an as-built record show the built solution matches this version of the design, with every departure either designed in a new version or recorded as a decision? | production | blocker | both |
| [PRD-BLD-03](prd-bld-03.md) | Are the automated fitness functions running in the delivery pipeline or continuously, and passing on the release candidate? | production | major | both |
| [PRD-EVD-01](prd-evd-01.md) | Was every piece of evidence the assessment relies on produced against the version being released? | production | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-EVD-02](prd-evd-02.md) | Do acceptance tests show the functional scenarios work end to end? | production | major | both |
| [PRD-HND-01](prd-hnd-01.md) | Has every assessment the design handed over returned an outcome for this version that is not a failure? | production | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-HND-02](prd-hnd-02.md) | Are the conditions and residual risks those assessments returned accepted by the person each one names? | production | major | reviewer |
| [PRD-OPS-01](prd-ops-01.md) | Is a team named to run the solution, with its hours, on-call cover and escalation? | production | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-OPS-02](prd-ops-02.md) | Does every SLO alert the support team when it is at risk, and is the solution in the monitoring it will be run with? | production | major | both |
| [PRD-OPS-03](prd-ops-03.md) | Is there a runbook, and has an operational readiness review of this version passed? | production | major | tool |
| [PRD-REL-01](prd-rel-01.md) | Has rollback of this release been tested, and is the point after which rollback becomes recovery known? | production | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-REL-02](prd-rel-02.md) | Has recovery been tested against the stated recovery time and recovery point objectives? | production | major | tool |
| [PRD-REL-03](prd-rel-03.md) | Has a load test exercised the high-importance performance and reliability scenarios at the expected peak? | production | major | both |
| [PRD-REL-04](prd-rel-04.md) | Are the cutover, any data migration, and the retirement of what the solution replaces planned and owned? | production | major | reviewer |
| [PRD-RSK-01](prd-rsk-01.md) | Does every risk, debt item and accepted finding carried into production have an owner entitled to accept it, and a date? | production | blocker | both |
| [PRD-RSK-02](prd-rsk-02.md) | Are the conditions of this assessment each owned and dated, and is the first periodic assessment scheduled? | production | major | reviewer |
| [PRD-AI-01](prd-ai-01.md) | Do the gating evals pass on the release candidate? | production | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-AI-02](prd-ai-02.md) | Are drift monitoring and at least one online eval switched on for every model-backed element? | production | major | tool |
| [PRD-AI-03](prd-ai-03.md) | Have the agent's limits, approval gates and kill switch been shown to work, without the agent's cooperation? | production | blocker | tool |
